The '''Royal Mines''' are is a section of the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}} located below {{Zone|Palace Bridge}}, and connected to {{Zone|Cliffside Veins}}, and {{Zone|Aristocrat Passage}}.

== Purpose ==
The '''Royal Mines''' not only contains {{Item|Mithril}}, but also veins of [[Ores|Pure]] {{Item|Coal}}, {{Item|Iron}}, {{Item|Gold}}, {{Item|Lapis}}, {{Item|Redstone}}, {{Item|Emerald}}, and {{Item|Diamond}}.

A tunnel connects the main section to a lower part of the '''Royal Mines''', where a {{NPCSprite|Ticket Master}} can be found. This section also leads to the {{Zone|Great Ice Wall}}.
